Hausa: Mahalarta taron ba su ma san cewa hanyoyin bincike sun haɗa da al'adar da aka saba na nazarin sawun yatsa ba.
Northern Sotho: Bakgathatema ba be ba sa lemoge le gatee gore ditshepedišo tša forensiki di akaretša tiro ye e tlwaelegilego ya go sekaseka dkgatišo tša menwana.
Amharic: ተሳታፊዎቹ በአብዛኛው የፎረንሲክ ሂደቶች የተለመደውን የጣት አሻራዎችን የመተንተን ተግባር እንደሚያካትቱ አንኳ አያውቁም ነበር፡፡

Source: A few who did know about forensic science had learnt about it from television series and documentaries.
Luganda: Abatono abaali bamanyi ebikwata ku ssaayansi akozesebwa mu kunoonyereza ku misango baali baabiyigira mu bintu ebiragibwa ku ttivvi ne pulogulaamu eziraga ebintu ebyali bibaddewo.
Yoruba: Díẹ̀ lára àwọn tí kò mọ̀ nípa ìmọ sáyẹ́nsì ajẹmófin kọ́ nípa rẹ̀ nínú àwọn ètò orí ẹ̀rọ ìgbóhùn-gbáwòrán-sáfẹ́fẹ́ àti àwọn ìwé ìtàn.
Zulu: Abambalwa ababazi ngobuchwepheshe befolenziki babefunde ngabo ochungechungeni lukamabonakude nakumadokhumentari.
Hausa: Wasu 'yan da suka san ilimin kimiyyar shari'a sun koyi game da shi daga jerin shirye-shiryen talabijin da takardun shaida.
Northern Sotho: Ba mmalwa bao ba bego ba sa tsebe ka ga mahlale a tša forensiki ba ithutile ka ga ona ka mananeo a thelebišene le ka go ditokumenthari.
Amharic: ስለ ፎረንሲክ ሳይንስ የሚያውቁት ጥቂቶች ስለ ጉዳዩ የተማሩት ከቴሌቪዥን ተከታታይ እና ዘጋቢ ፊልሞች ነበር፡፡

Source: The researchers reported that 81.5% of their participants said the state of forensics in Ghana was bad, while only 10.5% said it was good, and 8% said it was very bad.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti ebitundu 81.5% eby’abeetabi baabwe baagamba nti embeera ya ssaayansi akozesebwa mu kunoonyereza ku misango mu Ghana yali mbi, ebitundu 10.5% baagamba nti yali nnungi, olwo ebitundu 8% ne bagamba nti yali mbi.
Yoruba: Àbọ̀ ìwádìí fihàn pé akópa 81.5% ní wọ́n sọ pé ipò ìwádìí ajẹmófin ní orílẹ̀èdè Ghana kò dára, àwọn 10.5% sọ pé ó dára, 8% sì wí pé ó burú jáì.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babike ukuthi ama-81.5% wababambiqhaza babo athe isimo socwaningo lwezentengiselwano eGhana sibi, kanti i-10.5% lithe sihle, i-8% sathi sibi kakhulu.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun bayyana cewa kashi 81.5% na mahalartansu sun ce yanayin binciken kwakwaf a Ghana ba shi da kyau, yayin da kashi 10.5% kawai suka ce yana da kyau, kashi 8% kuma suka ce ya yi muni matuka.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba begile gore 81.5% ya bakgathatema ba bona ba boletše gore seemo sa tša forensiki ka Ghana se be se fokola, mola e le gore 10.5% e boletše gore seemo se lokile, gomme 8% e boletše gore e be e fokola kudu.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንደዘገቡት፣ 81.5% ተሳታፊዎች በጋና ያለው የፎረንሲክ ሁኔታ መጥፎ ነው ሲሉ ፣10.5% ብቻ የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ጥሩ ነው፣ 8% ደግሞ በጣም መጥፎ ነው ይላሉ፡፡

Source: They also noted that forensic knowledge, awareness and perceptions were influenced by the participants’ level of education.
Luganda: Baakyoleka n’okukyoleka nti okumanya, okutegeera n’entwala abantu ze balina ku ssaayansi akozesebwa mu kunoonyereza ku misango byasinziira ku ddaala ly’abeetabi ery’obuyigirize.
Yoruba: Bẹ́ẹ̀ náà ni wọ́n wòye pé ìmọ̀ àti ìwòye tí àwọn akópa ní nípa ìwádìí ajẹmófin kò ṣẹ̀yìn ìpele tí ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan wọ́n kàwé dé.
Zulu: Baphinde baphawula ukuthi ulwazi lwefolenziki, ukuqwashiseka kanye nemibono kuthonywa izinga lemfundo yababambiqhaza.
Hausa: Har ila yau, sun lura cewa ilimin shari'a, wayar da kan jama'a da kuma fahimtar matakin ilimin mahalarta ya tasiri.
Northern Sotho: Ba lemogile gape gore tsebo ya tša forensiki, temogo le maikutlo ka ga yona e hueditšwe ka maemo a thuto a bakgathatema.
Amharic: የተሳታፊዎቹ የትምህርት ደረጃ በፎረንሲክ እውቀት፣ግንዛቤ እና መረዳት ላይ ተጽእኖ እንዳለውም አስተውለዋል፡፡

Source: During the study, many participants became interested in forensics and said it could help in justice delivery in Ghana.
Luganda: Ng’okunoonyereza kugenda mu maaso, abeetabi bangi baatuuka ekiseera ne baagala ssaayansi akozesebwa mu kunoonyereza ku misango era ne bagamba nti asobola okuyamba mu kutuusa obwenkanya mu Ghana.
Yoruba: Nígbà tí ìwádìí yìí lọ, ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn akópa ní wọ́n bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí nífẹ̀ẹ́ sí ìwádìí ajẹmófin, wọ́n sì sọ pé yóò wúlò fún ṣíṣẹ ìdájọ́ tó yẹ ní orílẹ̀èdè Ghana.
Zulu: Phakathi nocwaningo, ababambiqhaza abaningi baba nentshisekelo kwifolenziki futhi bathi ingasiza ekulethweni kobulungiswa eGhana.
Hausa: A yayin binciken, mahalarta da yawa sun zama masu sha'awar bincike kuma sun ce zai iya taimakawa wajen tabbatar da adalci a Ghana.
Northern Sotho: Ka nakong ya dinyakišišo, bakgathatema ba bantši ba ile ba ba le kgahlego ka go tša forensiki gomme ba bolela gore e ka thuša ka phethagatšong ya toka ka Ghana.
Amharic: በጥናቱ ወቅት ብዙ ተሳታፊዎች በፎረንሲክ ላይ ብዙ ፍላጎት ያደረባቸው ሲሆን በጋና ፍርድ አሰጣጥ ላይ ሊረዳ ይችላልም ብለዋል፡፡

Source: Only a few, 13%, were against it.
Luganda: Bo abaali tebamwagala baali batono ddala, ebitundu 13%.
Yoruba: Díẹ̀ tó jẹ́ 13% ni kò faramọ́ ọn.
Zulu: Bambalwa kuphela, i-13%, ababemelene nakho.
Hausa: Kadan ne kawai, 13%, suka yi adawa da shi.
Northern Sotho: Ke ba mmalwa fela, 13%, bao ba bego ba le kgahlanong le se.
Amharic: ጥቂቶች፣ 13% የሚሆኑት ብቻ ተቃውመውት ነበር፡፡

Source: The researchers said the government of Ghana should enforce forensic science if they want to achieve peace and security.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti gavumenti ya Ghana esaanye ekozese ssaayansi akozesebwa mu kunoonyereza ku misango bwe baba nga baagala okufuna eddembe n’obukuumi.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí gba ìjọba Ghana ní ìmọ̀ràn láti kan ìmọ̀ sáyẹ́nsì ajẹmófin ní ipá tí wọ́n bá fẹ́ àláfíyà àti ààbọ.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi uhulumeni waseGhana kufanele asebenzise ubuchwepheshe befolenziki uma befuna ukuzuza ukuthula nokuvikeleka.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce kamata ya yi gwamnatin Ghana ta tilasta bin doka da oda idan suna son samun zaman lafiya da tsaro.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore mmušo wa Ghana o swanetše go diriša mahlale a tša forensiki ka nepo ya go fihlelela khutšo le tšhireletšego.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ የጋና መንግስት ሰላምን እና ደህንነትን ለማስፈን ከፈለገ ፎረንሲክ ሳይንስን ማስፈጸም አለበት ብለዋል፡፡

Source: They recommended that similar studies be done in other parts of Ghana.
Luganda: Baateesa nti okunoonyereza nga kuno kusaanye kukolebwe mu bitundu bya Ghana ebirala.
Yoruba: Wọ́n dábàá pé kí irú ìwádìí yìí tún wáyé ní àwọn apá mìíràn ní Ghana.
Zulu: Bancome ukuthi kwenziwe izifundo ezifanayo kwezinye izingxenye zeGhana.
Hausa: Sun ba da shawarar a yi irin wannan nazari a wasu sassan Ghana.
Northern Sotho: Ba šišintše gore dinyakišišo tša go swana le tše di dirwe ka dikarolong tše dingwe tša Ghana.
Amharic: በሌሎች የጋና አካባቢዎችም ተመሳሳይ ጥናቶች እንዲደረጉ መክረዋል፡፡

Source: The researchers also recommended that the government should prioritise forensic science in Ghana by teaching the subject at all school levels, and by establishing a forensic science institution.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baateesa nti gavumenti esaanye esoosawaze ssaayansi akozesebwa mu kunoonyereza ku misango mu Ghana nga bayita mu kumusomesa ku madaala g’okusoma gonna, awamu n’okuteekawo ettendekero eritendeka ssaayansi akozesebwa mu kunoonyereza ku misango.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí gba ìjọba ní ìyànjú pé kí wọ́n mú ìmọ̀ sáyẹ́nsì ajẹmófin ní ọ̀kúnkúndùn ní orílẹ̀-èdè Ghana nípa kíkọ́ ọ ní oríṣiríṣi ìpele ní àwọn ilé-ẹ̀kọ́, àti dídá àwọn ìgbékalè sílẹ̀ fún ìmọ̀ sáyẹ́nsì ajẹmófin.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphinde bancoma ukuthi uhulumeni kufanele abeke eqhulwini ubuchwepheshe befolenziki eGhana ngokufundisa lesi sifundo kuwo wonke amazinga ezikole, nangokusungula isikhungo sobuchwepheshe befolenziki.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma ba da shawarar cewa kamata ya yi gwamnati ta ba da fifiko kan kimiyyar binciken kwakwaf a Ghana ta hanyar koyar da wannan fanni a dukkan matakan makarantu, da kuma kafa wata cibiyar binciken kimiyya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba šišintše gape gore mmušo o swanetše go bea pele mahlale a tša forensiki ka Ghana ka go ruta thuto ye ka maemong a dikolo ka moka, le go hloma sehlongwa sa mahlale a tša forensiki.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ መንግስት በጋና ትምህርቱን በሁሉም የትምህርት ቤት ደረጃዎች በመስጠት እና የፎረንሲክ ሳይንስ ተቋምን በማቋቋም ለፎረንሲክ ሳይንስ ቅድሚያ ሊሰጥ እንደሚገባ አሳስበዋል፡፡
